  └ (60 lines of pane output)

  The capture works, but `--format ansi` is still ignored: the
  pane comes back cooked because capture-pane is called without
  -e. One line in src/driver/tmux.rs.

  Two options:
    1. Always pass -e and strip in the caller.
    2. Pass -e only when the caller asked for ansi.

  Option 2 keeps the default output identical to today's, so
  nothing downstream changes. I would take that one unless you
  want the raw bytes everywhere.

  Files I would touch:
    src/driver/tmux.rs    capture_pane gains a flag
    src/cli/agent.rs      --format threads through
    src/driver/tests.rs   one case per format
